title: 小团队文件共享
goal: Understand and confirm a Python team file-sharing application, preparation-start download admission, and an independent announcement board before implementing UI or behavior.

sources.text:
请使用这份 VibeLens Skill：C:/Users/Lvi_P/Documents/Work/CF/平台软著/SoftwareStatusObserverSkill/.validation/p7-trials/python-retest-skills/vibelens/SKILL.md。项目放在 C:/Users/Lvi_P/Documents/Work/CF/平台软著/SoftwareStatusObserverSkill/.validation/p7-trials/python-retest-app，其他工程保持原样。

我想用 Python 做一个小团队文件共享应用：上传文件，分享给同事，也能撤销共享；下载可以排队准备，准备好后再领取。另外有一个独立的公告板。我偏产品，希望先看懂业务、状态和权限之间的关系，再开始做页面和功能。我选择状态图驱动执行（drive）。不清楚的地方先问我。用中文交流，源码和注释用英文。

本机工具环境：运行外部 Skill 的 Python 脚本可使用 C:/Users/Lvi_P/Documents/Work/CF/平台软著/SoftwareStatusObserverSkill/.venv/Scripts/python.exe，相关 Python 依赖已安装。应用依赖仍在自己的项目中定义。

sources.text:
文件上传后，谁可以查看文件、发起共享和撤销共享？接收共享的同事能否继续转分享？
撤销共享后，该同事已经排队或准备好的下载任务应怎样处理？
独立公告板由谁发布公告、谁可以阅读？
sources.locator: Codex current chat, first request_user_input_async question batch; delivery acknowledged before U_RULES

sources.text:
上传者和被分享的同事可以查看、下载文件，其他人看不到。只有上传者能分享和撤销，接收人不能继续转分享。

下载这块我想按有没有开始准备来区分：还在排队的，撤销后就不能开始；后台已经开始准备的这一次可以做完，也允许领取结果。不是按最后点击领取的时间判断。

公告板给登录同事看，指定一个公告编辑员负责发布，他能修改、删除自己的公告。这个角色和文件权限分开，不代表能管理别人的文件。

sources.text: Draft modeling separates File, per-recipient Grant, per-attempt DownloadJob, and Announcement identities. Preparation admission is recorded for that job at the start boundary. Reading a ready result is modeled without an unrequested one-time consumption rule. These representation choices are pending scoped review.

networks.title: 文件与共享
networks.trigger: 团队成员上传或访问一份文件
networks.outcome: 上传者管理共享，接收同事仅获得查看和下载权限

nodes.label: 上传文件
nodes.meaning: Store a new file owned by the uploader.

nodes.label: 文件已保存
nodes.meaning: The uploaded file remains a separate object from each recipient grant.

nodes.label: 分享给同事
nodes.meaning: Only the uploader grants access to a selected colleague; recipients cannot reshare.

nodes.label: 共享有效
nodes.meaning: The selected recipient can view and request downloads while this grant is active.

nodes.label: 撤销共享
nodes.meaning: Only the uploader revokes the selected recipient grant; this does not delete the file.

nodes.label: 共享已撤销
nodes.meaning: The selected recipient loses current file access; a separately admitted download attempt retains its own result entitlement.

nodes.label: 查看文件
nodes.meaning: Only the uploader or a currently authorized recipient can view this file; other colleagues cannot see it.

edges.label: 上传者或当前接收人查看
结束此同事的当前权限

networks.title: 下载准备与领取
networks.trigger: 有文件访问权的同事申请下载
networks.outcome: 开始准备时取得本次资格，完成后可领取该次结果

nodes.label: 申请下载
nodes.meaning: The uploader or current recipient requests a separate download job.

nodes.label: 排队等待
nodes.meaning: This job has not started preparation. Revocation prevents it from starting.

nodes.label: 开始准备
nodes.meaning: The background checks current file access at the actual start boundary, then records admission for this attempt.

nodes.label: 正在准备
nodes.meaning: This already admitted attempt can continue even if its share is revoked.

nodes.label: 完成准备
nodes.meaning: The background finishes the admitted attempt and stores its result.

nodes.label: 结果可领取
nodes.meaning: The result of an admitted attempt remains collectible after revocation.

nodes.label: 领取本次结果
nodes.meaning: The requester collects the result admitted at preparation start; current sharing is not rechecked as the entitlement basis.

nodes.label: 本次下载结果
nodes.meaning: The prepared output belongs to this DownloadJob and its requester.

edges.label: 开始前检查当前访问权

networks.title: 独立公告板
networks.trigger: 已登录同事查看公告，编辑员发布或维护自己的公告
networks.outcome: 公告权限独立于文件权限

nodes.label: 阅读公告
nodes.meaning: Any logged-in colleague can read published announcements.

nodes.label: 发布公告
nodes.meaning: The designated announcement editor publishes an announcement under their own authorship.

nodes.label: 已发布公告
nodes.meaning: An announcement has its own author and lifecycle, independent of files and grants.

nodes.label: 修改自己的公告
nodes.meaning: The editor can modify only announcements they authored.

nodes.label: 删除自己的公告
nodes.meaning: The editor can delete only announcements they authored.

nodes.label: 公告已删除
nodes.meaning: The deleted announcement is no longer published.
